description: This file defines a YAML-based schema for TLV (Type-Length-Value) structures related to WFA Map and MLD configurations, including class definitions, structures, and fields used for network configuration data.

classes.name: tlvAgentApMldConfiguration
classes.description: Main class representing the Agent MLD Configuration with type, length, and list of AP MLD entries.

classes.name: cApMld
classes.description: Represents individual AP MLD entries including MAC address, modes, and affiliations.

classes.name: sApMldMacAddrValid
classes.description: Struct indicating whether the MAC address is valid.

classes.name: sModes
classes.description: Struct representing various enabled/disabled modes for the AP MLD configuration.

classes.name: cAffiliatedAp
classes.description: Represents an affiliated AP with fields for MAC address, link ID, and validity flags.

classes.name: sAffiliatedApFieldsValid
classes.description: Struct indicating validity of various fields within an affiliated AP entry.
